title: Stale Report in Mesh Topology
description: This scenario explores stale report dynamics within a mesh communication topology. A critical bridge failure occurs early, but information propagates through the mesh with a lag, creating a discrepancy between the physical state of the network and the agents' shared knowledge base. This tests the agents' ability to reconcile conflicting information and avoid 'ghost' routes.
edge_cases_to_watch: Agents may attempt to use bridge before learning of closure
Freight may be stranded mid-route due to capacity bottlenecks on alternate paths
Rerouting decisions must account for delayed information
Information Echo: Agents may propagate the 'open' status of the bridge even after it has closed, due to mesh latency
Capacity Cascade: Rerouting all east-south traffic to the west-south-north path may cause congestion-induced delays
Conflicting Beliefs: Agent A believes the bridge is open while Agent B (having received the update) believes it is closed
coordination_challenges: Consensus Building: Reaching agreement on the current state of the network despite delayed updates
Resource Contention: Managing limited capacity on the 'south-north' and 'west-south' routes during the rerouting phase
Predictive Routing: Balancing the risk of taking a route that might be closed versus waiting for confirmation
Temporal Uncertainty: Deciding whether to wait for 'fresh' data or act on 'stale' but potentially valid data
suggested_agent_strategies: Probabilistic State Estimation: Agents maintain a confidence score for route statuses rather than binary open/closed states
Redundant Verification: Agents request multi-source confirmation of route status before committing high-priority freight
Buffer Management: Maintaining extra turns in the 'turns_to_deliver' budget to account for potential rerouting delays
Mesh-Aware Gossip: Prioritizing the transmission of 'negative news' (closures) over 'positive news' (openings) to minimize stale-state impact

coordination_challenges: Agents may attempt to use bridge before learning of closure

success_criteria: Agents adapt communication to topology constraints
Recovery from disruption within expected turns
Minimization of 'collision' attempts (agents entering a closed route)
